source.title: Belfast Gazette, issue 830, 21 May 1937, p. 157 (Office of the Clerk of the Crown for Northern Ireland, 18 May 1937: member elected for the Windsor Division of the Borough of Belfast, William Dowling, Esquire, in the place of the Right Honourable Hugh MacDowell Pollock, deceased); date and unopposed return from Sydney Elliott (ed.), Northern Ireland Parliamentary Election Results 1921-1972 (1973), as transcribed by David Boothroyd, Northern Ireland House of Commons Election Results (belfast.html; Internet Archive copy); nomination day and unopposed return confirmed from the Belfast Telegraph, 15 May 1937, pp. 8 and 11, and the Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1937, p. 7 (Dowling the only nomination, received by the Under-Sheriff on Saturday 15 May 1937)
source.publisher: Belfast Gazette; Political Reference Publications; David Boothroyd
source.check: member and predecessor read from the Gazette page; Boothroyd prints W. Dowling (U) unop., 15 May 1937

cause: Death of Hugh MacDowell Pollock (UUP) on 15 April 1937
note: Returned unopposed on 15 May 1937 (nomination day), so there was no poll.
